dedupe_keys.name: plateau building and hazard data preparation pipeline

description: This Python pipeline converts Project PLATEAU 3D city data into per-building tables that can support hazard-exposure analysis in Japan. It extracts building identities and attributes from CityGML, intersects buildings with river flood, inland flood, tsunami, storm-surge and landslide layers, and writes GeoParquet plus map-friendly PMTiles and FlatGeobuf. The README stresses a coverage flag: a building outside a surveyed zone must remain unknown, not being treated as safe. A modeller could query the resulting table with DuckDB to select vulnerable buildings or construct scenario inputs. The project authors document 29 prebuilt city bundles, but this record covers the reusable preparation code; the separate data release has its own draft. Building and hazard coverage varies by city and dataset year. This review checked documentation, repository metadata and release listings, not the geometry, numerical intersections or pipeline execution. The software is MIT-licensed. Original PLATEAU data and redistributed derived bundles are CC BY 4.0 with attribution, while any separately joined OSM database may create additional obligations. Related resources are the source CityGML and the distinct prebuilt bundle collection.
